sections.body: Robots and computers follow steps, one at a time. 🤖
The ORDER matters! Socks go on before shoes. 🧦👟
If the steps are mixed up, things go wrong. Shoes then socks? Silly! 😄
Be a robot! A grown-up gives you steps: 'Walk 2 steps. Turn around. Clap!'
Take turns being the 'robot' and the 'programmer'. Follow instructions very literally, so children see why clear steps matter.

hints: When we eat cereal, first the bowl, then the cereal. For feet, which goes on first?

quiz.q: A robot is making a sandwich 🥪. What is the LAST step?
hints: Think of the start and the end.
Getting the bread happens at the start.
Building a tower: first the bottom block, last the TOP block. A sandwich is like that!
quiz.explain: The top bread goes on last! 🥪
